title: DW3 port sprites/<name>/sprite.json (sprites-sprite-v1, also sprite-v1)
description: A sprite: PNG frames, animations and animation sets (data/sprites/<name>/sprite.json with NNN.png, or the same folder in a mod's sprites/<name>/). Two uses with one format. The EXPORT (pc/shim/sprite_data.c, process; pc/shim/sprite_export.c) is written from the disc with "source", "set_table", "directions" and "notes" and is read back (imgSpriteOverridesBuild) to replace the original's frames. A mod's NEW sprite is read by sprBankAdd in the same file, which needs format, frames, animations and sets (each a list of at least one) and takes an optional actor_width; it ignores the other members. The reader accepts format sprites-sprite-v1 and also sprite-v1, the name a partner's field/ folder writes (partners/<name>/field/sprite.json). A frame is a 4-bit PNG of 16 colours at most (index 0 transparent), at most the slot size of the sprite bank.

source.description: Export only: the disc file the sprite comes from, without DAT/ (FIELD/SPRT/P001PLAY.BIN). Informational.

set_table.description: Export only: the archive entry that holds the set table, or -1 when the file has none (then animations and sets are empty). Informational.

actor_width.description: Mod sprite: the width of the actor in pixels (how far apart it stands from others). When absent it is the width of the widest frame an animation uses.

frames.description: One PNG each. A mod sprite needs at least one.

id.description: Unique among frames and animations (they share one list of ids). In an export it is the entry's index in the disc archive.

image.description: A plain .png file name in the sprite's folder (export: NNN.png with the id).

w.description: Export only: the PNG's width in pixels.

used.description: Export only, written when false: no animation of this file uses the frame.

animations.description: A mod sprite needs at least one.

loop.description: true (the default when absent) repeats from the first step; false stops on the last frame.

ticks.description: Export only: the total length in game ticks.

error.description: Export only: the disc's animation has no end marker.

time.description: How long the frame shows, in game ticks (1 or more in a mod).

sets.description: Animation sets the game asks for by id. A mod sprite needs at least one.

id.description: The set id the game requests.

name.description: Export only: the decompilation's ACTOR_ANIM_* identifier.

animations.description: Animation ids: five (one per facing slot) or a single one used for all five.

directions.description: Export only, fixed: which slot each of the 8 facings uses and which are mirrored (a mirrored frame is drawn flipped; its x becomes -(w + x)).
